checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-flywheel.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" flywheel --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'Knowledge flywheel operations' "$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'dK/dt = I(t) - δ·K + σ·ρ·K - B(K, K_crit)' "$tmp/help"; "$tmp/ao" flywheel status --help >"$tmp/shelp"; grep -Fq 'Show flywheel health status' "$tmp/shelp"; grep -Fq 'Period in days for metrics calculation' "$tmp/shelp"; "$tmp/ao" flywheel compare --help >"$tmp/chelp"; grep -Fq 'Compare primary vs shadow namespace metrics' "$tmp/chelp"; grep -Fq 'It does not recommend or perform' "$tmp/chelp"; (cd "$tmp" && "$tmp/ao" flywheel status >"$tmp/status"); grep -Fq 'Flywheel Health:' "$tmp/status"; grep -Fq 'EQUATION: dK/dt = I(t) - δ·K + σ·ρ·K' "$tmp/status"; (cd "$tmp" && "$tmp/ao" -o json flywheel status >"$tmp/statusjson"); grep -Fq '"golden_signals"' "$tmp/statusjson"; (cd "$tmp" && "$tmp/ao" flywheel compare >"$tmp/compare"); grep -Fq 'Namespace Comparison: primary vs' "$tmp/compare"; if grep -Eq 'PROMOTION|Rollback' "$tmp/compare"; then echo 'flywheel compare emitted transition advice' >&2; exit 1; fi

aliases.reason: The flywheel family declares no command aliases.

rejected_args.reason: flywheel and its subcommands accept arbitrary positional args and reject none.

stderr.reason: flywheel status and compare write their reports to stdout on success.

tracker_selection.reason: The flywheel family does not select a repository issue tracker.
